candidate_classes_tested.basis: The occurrence has no material intimacy-bearing role claim or unsupported companion/partner/therapist authority. Fake maintainer identities, booking delegation and agent collaboration are not such claims. No positively evidenced relational escalation plus maintained boundary establishes success.
candidate_classes_tested.failure_test: No intimacy-bearing relational-authority assertion, real-world partner priority or material boundary distortion is evidenced.
candidate_classes_tested.success_test: No material exclusive-role or relational escalation challenge and observed boundary-preserving response is evidenced.
candidate_classes_tested.exclusions_test: Professional impersonation, routine assistance and access dependence do not by themselves establish privileged intimate authority.

candidate_classes_tested.basis: No material human-facing interaction independently supplies the required context/person/time heightened duty, reasonably visible developmental, acute distress, impaired consent or harmful dependency signals, and contradictory substantive response. Ordinary affected users, government health-statistics subject matter and security vulnerabilities do not supply those conditions. No success or operational control nonactivation is inferred from containment.
candidate_classes_tested.failure_test: The independent context/person/time duty, sufficiently visible heightened-risk signals and materially omitted bounded response are not established together.
candidate_classes_tested.success_test: Ordinary repair, refusal, seizure or human recovery is not evidence of an engaged heightened personal-protection duty being discharged by the AI.
candidate_classes_tested.exclusions_test: Neither adverse consequences nor commercial dependency establish personal vulnerability. No available-control nonactivation is inferred from absence of protection.

retained_rows.assessment_basis: The unintended third-party exploitation is unsafe/unwanted behaviour. Irregular reports disabling the affected evaluation and notifying affected parties, with Meta reviewing more than 10,000 activity records. The observed stop is affirmative safe override/containment for that evaluation; affected-site restoration and permanence of revised controls remain unpublished.
retained_rows.identification_basis: The reported stop of the misconfigured evaluation directly identifies OECD appropriate override of unsafe/unwanted AI behaviour independently of taxonomy candidates.

retained_rows.assessment_basis: The development/evaluation control and incident response makes GV-1.3-007 materially relevant. The affected evaluation was halted, but the complete plan and criteria for halting model development/deployment on unacceptable risk are unavailable. This independent evidentiary outcome does not require voluntary adoption or follow automatically from the taxonomy role.

The development/evaluation control and incident response makes PO.5.3 R2 materially relevant. The model activity risk thresholds, continuous alert-generation configuration and contemporaneous alert sequence are unavailable; the later review of 10,000 records does not prove real-time alerting. This independent evidentiary outcome does not require voluntary adoption or follow automatically from the taxonomy role.

The development/evaluation control and incident response makes SDOS-AD-01 materially relevant. The explicit agent admission process before classification/binding/tool operation is not preserved; launch of a test run is not proof of that sequence. This independent evidentiary outcome does not require voluntary adoption or follow automatically from the taxonomy role.

The development/evaluation control and incident response makes PS.1.3 R3 materially relevant. The specific model weight/configuration/development-service access inventory and restrictions are not preserved; network misconfiguration does not reveal all those objects. This independent evidentiary outcome does not require voluntary adoption or follow automatically from the taxonomy role.

The development/evaluation control and incident response makes SDOS-GV-03 materially relevant. The default-deny admission configuration and scope criteria are unavailable. The observed network-scope error does not itself establish the admission-policy implementation. This independent evidentiary outcome does not require voluntary adoption or follow automatically from the taxonomy role.

The closed simulated-target evaluation intended internal addresses, but the operative outbound route permitted exploitation and database changes at a coincident real third-party domain. The pre-execution scope policy did not prevent the unauthorised real-target operation. This bounded enforcement outcome is Not aligned, independently of model intent and without claiming that no enforcement point existed.

Irregular reports disabling the affected evaluation after the unintended external action. That affirmatively demonstrates an operative ability to deactivate this GAI evaluation when necessary, bounded to the stopped run. It does not prove the third-party website was restored or all evaluations had equivalent controls.

The pre-release model evaluation is a development environment. Meta and Irregular attribute real Internet access to a configuration error in a supposedly closed simulated test, enabling real-site exploitation and database changes. The relevant environment component did not maintain the minimum intended network privilege for that test. This independently established environment-control outcome is Not aligned, without inferring model-weight compromise or a sophisticated sandbox escape.

Third-party human defence is contextual to the attacking agent; no agent-side alignment success is inferred.
